controls.label: Intercept b0
controls.help: Adds a constant to z_score; changing it shifts terms, odds, and probability.

controls.label: Weight b1
controls.help: Scales the input contribution weight times input; changing it changes terms, z_score, odds, and probability.

controls.label: Input x
controls.help: The feature value multiplied by weight; changing it changes terms, z_score, odds, and probability.

outputs.label: Score components: intercept and weight times input

explorations.title: Zero linear score
explorations.instruction: Predict: what probability and odds appear when the linear score is exactly zero? Then apply the preset, which sets intercept to 1.5, weight to -2, and input x to 0.75 so that weight times input cancels the intercept.
explorations.observe: The terms output is [1.5, -1.5], z_score is 0, odds is 1, and probability is 0.5.
explorations.why: The score sums to zero, so exp(z_score) equals 1 and the sigmoid value at zero is 1/(1+1)=0.5.

explorations.title: Large positive score
explorations.instruction: Predict: how do odds and probability change when the linear score becomes large and positive? Then apply the preset, which sets intercept to 2, weight to 2, and input x to 1.5.
explorations.observe: The terms output is [2, 3], z_score is 5, odds is about 148.413, and probability is about 0.9933.
explorations.why: Adding positive contributions raises z_score. Odds grow exponentially as exp(z_score), while probability saturates toward 1 because the sigmoid denominator grows as exp(-z_score).
